Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. Add that Mengzi thinks the worshipping looks interesting, so readers understand why he copies it. e.g. 他觉得祭拜很有意思。
2. Add a detail that he laughs while copying the people who come to worship. e.g. 他一边笑，一边学别人祭拜。
3. Add a short reaction from his mother, such as apologizing to the worshippers. e.g. 妈妈说：“对不起。”

ideas.reason: This gives a simple motivation for why Mengzi keeps copying the worshippers.
This adds a concrete childlike action that fits his imitation of people at the cemetery.
The tale says his mother decides to move after seeing his behavior, not that he disturbs worshippers and she apologizes.
